title: Existing materials / review library
summary: Twelve selected base color previews from the existing local material library, plus one native export check. These are source samples, not proposed new textures or an approved palette. Click any image for the full review copy and download.

items.title: Concrete 01
items.alt: Concrete 01 existing base color texture preview
items.body:
**Existing library / not palette approval.** Existing general concrete; compare its scale on the current wall kit.

Source under `Utility_Materials`: `Concrete/Concrete_01/Concrete_01_basecolor.png`. Source image 512 × 512; this local review copy is bounded to 800 px. Albedo only: assess normal, roughness, material response and tiling in the engine before acceptance.

items.title: Designer / verified export sample
items.alt: 256 by 256 base color output produced by the installed Adobe cooker and renderer
items.body: **Tool verification, not a new material.** `Brutalist_Concrete_01.sbs` was cooked and rendered at 256 × 256 into a scratch folder using Designer 15.0.1. Base color, normal and ORM outputs were produced. Original source and game texture exports were not overwritten. Interactive graph edits remain unverified.
